lexical-win.teaches: A rare, exact term. The answer is titled “Why wasn't `creat` called `create`?” and BM25 puts it first; the embedding model has never learned the creat syscall and drifts to “What does the -e do in a bash shebang?”

fusion-win.text: How to delete a file to the trash in BASH (Linux)
fusion-win.teaches: BM25 finds the right words on the wrong topics (Thunderbird, Samba); dense finds the right topic but vaguely. Neither has “Make `rm` move to trash” in its top three, both rank it reasonably, and fusion rewards that agreement by putting it first.
